donorReadme: - Derived locally from the same USGS/NASA Magellan global mosaic source
- Purpose: softer shipped mobile-class Venus texture with reduced mosaic harshness
- Processing: same balanced pass as desktop, then resized to 2048x1024
- Derived locally from the USGS/NASA Magellan Venus C3-MDIR colorized global mosaic
- Purpose: softer shipped desktop-class Venus texture with reduced mosaic harshness
- Processing: light blur, contrast reduction, restrained color, light re-sharpen

coordinates.placement: latLonToXYZ in the donor src/entities/hotspot.ts, on Three.js SphereGeometry UVs
coordinates.longitudeDegrees: exactly as stored in features.json, placed by latLonToXYZ whatever the range; the donor stores values already in its own marker frame (see longitudeRange, markerLongitudeFromSource and donorReadmeNote)
coordinates.position: [radius * sin(phi) * sin(theta), radius * cos(phi), radius * sin(phi) * cos(theta)]
coordinates.donorReadmeNote: - The current Venus release plan now uses balanced derivatives from the USGS/NASA Magellan surface mosaic to preserve sharpness while reducing visible mosaic artifacts.
